  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255),
  `messages` text NOT NULL,
  `messageCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `conversationTranscripts_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
